note: AWAY DAYS media ledger (spec §29, 25.9.2026): one row per photograph of a ground, never a URL inside a component. Every row names its source page (or the owner's upload), the author as credited, the licence, and the year it was TAKEN — the page prints 'צילום מ-<year>' beside it, so a modern photo is never passed off as the ground on the night Hapoel played there. Files are written only by scripts/away-days/ingest-media.mjs (1600×900 + 900×1200 WebP, yellow counted on the decode, per file). Only Wikimedia Commons files under CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / PD, fetched from their file page, may be added as free-licence rows.
source: Wikimedia Commons file pages (per row) · the owner's own uploads (per row)
